title: Minimal RTP
description: A lightweight and simple Random Teleport plugin. Allows players to easily teleport to random locations in the world.
body:
# MinimalRTP

minimal async RTP plugin for Paper 1.21+

## Features
- Minimalistic
- Async
- MiniMessage Support
- Cooldowns

## Installation
- Download the jar file from the releases page.
- Place the jar file in the `plugins` folder of your Paper server.
- Restart the server.

## Permissions
- `minimalrtp.command.rtp` -> Permission to execute the RTP plugin
- `minimalrtp.cooldown.bypass` -> Permission to bypass the cooldown
